title: Forwarders face margin squeeze as growth cools and disruption persists
content:
The global freight forwarding market is still growing, but the industry’s easy gains appear to be over as slowing trade growth, geopolitical disruption, and persistent overcapacity squeeze margins.
According to Transport Intelligence’s latest Global Freight Forwarding Market Size & Forecast report, the market grew 4.4% in real terms in 2025, reaching €208.1bn ($240bn). However, growth is expected to slow sharply this year, the market forecast to expand by just 2.5%.

content:
